question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2018?
text: Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob have a son, Charlie, who was born on September 16th, 2017. Alice and Charlie live in a home for which Alice furnished 40% of the maintenance costs, and Bob the remaining 60%, since September 16th, 2017. Alice and Bob file jointly from 2017 to 2019. Alice and Bob's incomes in 2018 were $36991 and $41990 respectively. Alice and Bob take the standard deduction. From 2017 to 2019, Bob lived separately.
